findings.title: Stale crate references in forbidden-operations.json after archive-orphan retirement
findings.evidence: specs/cross-cutting/forbidden-operations.json:26 still lists `oya-foundry-fitness-archive-orphan-kernel` as the enforcer of FO-01 (no parallel canonical trees); line 92 still lists it as the sole enforcer of FO-07 (no editing legacy retired paths). PR-13 removed that crate from Cargo workspace members and deleted its source, leaving FO-07 with a non-existent enforcer and a 'mechanical' mode that no longer fires.
findings.fix: Update FO-01.enforcement.enforced_by to drop `oya-foundry-fitness-archive-orphan-kernel`; for FO-07 either replace the enforcer with the Foundry M-CC-P11 substrate cited in ADR-0118, or flip mode from `mechanical` to `cultural` with an explicit GAP note. Cite ADR-0118 in evidence.

findings.title: Stale crate-naming-audit entry references retired runner
findings.evidence: specs/cross-cutting/crate-naming-audit.json:108 still enumerates `oya-foundry-fitness-archive-orphan` as a workspace member, but PR-13 dropped both `crates/oya-foundry-fitness-archive-orphan-kernel` and `tools/oya-foundry-fitness-archive-orphan-app` from Cargo.toml. compliance_summary.total_workspace_members (264) and downstream counts are no longer accurate.

findings.title: masterplan.json index drift for IP-008
findings.evidence: specs/cross-cutting/masterplan.json:801-812 still has `status: stub` and title `Archive orchestration glue + archive-orphan lane (P6)` for M-CC-P01-IP-008, contradicting the PR-13 markdown change to `status: retired` and the retired title in `.omc/plans/.../IP-008-archive-glue.md`.

findings.title: Registry catalog YAMLs for retired crates not deleted
findings.evidence: User task claims `registry/catalog/oya-foundry-fitness-archive-orphan*.yaml (DELETED)` but `ls registry/catalog/` shows all three (`oya-foundry-fitness-archive-orphan.yaml`, `-app.yaml`, `-kernel.yaml`) still present on disk; no deletion appears in pr-13.diff. The catalog now references crates that no longer exist as workspace members.
findings.fix: Either delete the three YAMLs in a follow-up commit on the same PR branch, or add a `status: retired` block citing ADR-0118 and exclude them from any catalog enumeration.

findings.title: evidence/ip-008-archive-glue.json carries absolute /Users path
findings.evidence: evidence/agentic-pipeline/ip-008-archive-glue.json:16-30 still embeds `/Users/jasonlee/bominal/...` absolute paths in `changed_files`; PR-13 only appended two entries and rewrote summary/next_steps. The file has `schema_version: 1.0.0` but no `$schema`/`$id`/`_meta` block, so closed-enum/required-field validation cannot be mechanically checked.

summary: PR-13 retires the archive-orphan lane and removes its crate/source but leaves four downstream surfaces stale: forbidden-operations.json (FO-01, FO-07 enforced_by), crate-naming-audit.json (workspace member list + compliance counts), masterplan.json (IP-008 row), and the three registry/catalog YAMLs. The four spec JSONs themselves retain valid $schema/$id/_meta and closed enums — schema shape is intact, but referential integrity to the new post-retirement state is broken.
